incident.summary: During UAOS inheritance, the controller correctly observed that ENTRYPOINT.md still declared release 2.4.4 while CURRENT_SYSTEM.json declared 2.5.2, but the same response reported Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED and Evolution: NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER. Existing executable admission enforced problem-triggered research/reflection for material mutations, but the selected-agent read/report path lacked an explicit always-on problem-detection sentinel and a progress-report consistency invariant.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: ENTRYPOINT.md production release marker 2.4.4 contradicted CURRENT_SYSTEM.json release 2.5.2
the assistant explicitly classified the mismatch as a defect but then emitted Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED
tests/architecture/test_problem_research_floor.py validates assess_deliberation signals but does not validate selected-session progress-report consistency
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: UAOS should continuously detect problem signals while keeping expensive research/reflection event-triggered rather than permanently running heavy self-debate
turn-level problem detection and pre-mutation authority admission are separate control responsibilities
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected assumption: an always-on mutation sentinel is sufficient to guarantee problem-trigger cognition on read-only or reporting turns
rejected alternative: run full external research and heavy deliberation on every clean turn, because it adds latency/noise without improving clean-path assurance
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: IBM autonomic-computing MAPE-K pattern: continuous monitoring feeds analysis/planning/execution when conditions require it
Google SRE monitoring guidance: continuously observe systems but escalate actionable conditions rather than turning all observations into heavy incident work
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: mutation-only detection misses defects discovered during read-only authority inspection, as reproduced by this incident
full heavy deliberation on every no-problem turn would violate the existing lightweight clean-path requirement and create control-plane bloat

changes: add always-on lightweight problem-detection sentinel to DELIBERATION_POLICY and SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY
forbid progress reports from claiming NOT_TRIGGERED/NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER when the same turn reports a detected problem
synchronize ENTRYPOINT release metadata to CURRENT_SYSTEM 2.5.2 and document turn-level cognition
add regression tests for sentinel scope, report consistency and ENTRYPOINT/CURRENT_SYSTEM release synchronization
declare the turn-level problem-detection sentinel in CURRENT_SYSTEM without changing the UAOS release identity
